searchText: I'm not sure if this is explicitly against the guidelines for the server, but personally I'd prefer to not see ads here. There are already enough messages to keep track of 🙂 Kicked with a warning, and deleted the ad. Fully agree, this is not a place for advertisements, even if they are ethereum-related. And if you're going to play with the rules, don't make an ad with embeds and a page-long text. Something generic, no embeds, and short like the above ethglobal hackathon link is acceptable agreed - thanks <@!203220829473996800>!
